design_decisions.decision: Parent unprefixed, child routers untouched (they carry full /api prefixes), as the spec said; rejected prefix="/api" plus shortening children.
Parent built inside create_app, not module-level, to avoid route accumulation; rejected a module-level router.

Walker flattens app.routes via duck typing on effective_candidates(): installed FastAPI 0.162.0 stores include_router as lazy _IncludedRouter nodes (no .path, no copied routes), so iterating app.routes directly would see zero /api routes. Falls back to plain routes for older FastAPI (requirements.txt pins 0.159.1). Rejected relying on route.path of app.routes. It uses a private-ish FastAPI API; the non-vacuous count and self-check tests guard it.
For non-APIRoute contexts the path and dependant come from starlette_route (e.g. /ws), else the context.

implementation.deviations: Installed FastAPI (0.162.0) differs from the pinned 0.159.1; walker written to handle both shapes. I could not run against 0.159.1 to confirm the older shape (the fallback branch is untested). No other deviations. CLAUDE.md not edited.
implementation.self_critique: Least covered: the walker under the pinned 0.159.1 (only 0.162.0 installed locally); CI installs the pin, so the fallback branch matters there. Walker relies on FastAPI internals (effective_candidates, dependant), guarded by the positive-count and self-check tests.
